SUPER + K → Keybindings	lua	hl.dsp.keybindings.show()
SUPER + SPACE → Omarchy menu	lua	hl.dsp.menu.show()
SUPER + RETURN → Terminal	exec	omarchy-launch-terminal
SUPER SHIFT + RETURN → Browser	exec	omarchy-launch-browser
SUPER + F → Full screen	lua	hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "fullscreen" })
SUPER + W → Close window	lua	hl.dsp.window.close()
SUPER + LEFT MOUSE BUTTON → Move window	lua	hl.dsp.window.move({})
SUPER + RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON → Resize window	lua	hl.dsp.window.resize({})
